top_issues: Coverage numbers contradict each other (all viewports/themes): 目前收錄 says 104-1 至 115-1, the 已收錄學期 tile says 23, the 各校收錄狀態 header is 106–115, and /schools lists 21 terms per school. Pick one period and one counting rule and use it in all four places.
歷史累計修課人數排行 top 10 is dominated by 班級活動 / PE / 服務學習, which answers 'what do students actually take' badly. Add a default '排除班會／體育／服務學習' toggle (or exclude 0 學分) and state the rule in 計算方式.

The trend column (desktop and phone) mixes a filled area (row 1), flat lines, and dotted runs (NTHU PE rows) that look like broken sparklines. Use one rule: a line for consecutive terms, dots only for gaps, plus a one-line legend.

The 各校收錄狀態 grid on desktop is all 2s for every school, so it carries no information, and about 400 px of empty space sits between column 115 and 累計班次. Shrink it and put a 累計班次 bar there, or replace it with a per-school offerings sparkline.
School rows in the same table are not sorted (清華 61,018 above 臺大 196,111). Sort by 累計班次 descending or by school code, and show the sort arrow.
Ranking rows link both the Chinese and the English title with underlines (desktop), which doubles the underline noise. Link the Chinese title only and render English as muted text.
keep: Search-first masthead with filters and hot chips; full-width 搜尋 on phone
Tabular stat tiles and rank bars drawn to one scale
On phone the ranking becomes stacked rows that keep the bar and the trend

top_issues: Results for 「資料」 across all schools and terms (desktop/phone) list 35 中正 rows, then 15 逢甲 rows, sorted by school id; NTU, NTHU and others never appear on page 1. Default to relevance (exact title > title contains > newest term) or interleave schools, and add a 排序 select.

The 修課人數／名額 column (desktop) is '—' for every 中正 row, so the bar column is empty for half the page. When a school never publishes enrollment, say it once (school chip or footnote) instead of repeating '—' 35 times, and collapse the column.
Row heights range from 48 px to 120 px because 逢甲 time/room strings wrap to 4 lines (e.g. (三)06 紀302(電腦實習室)…). Truncate the room to one muted line with a tooltip.

Desktop tables (light and dark): every cell is an underlined link (course, department, teacher), which reads as a wall of underlines. Underline on hover only inside data tables and keep the course title as the primary link.
Over-capacity values like '62 / 5' and '69 / 5' draw a full orange bar with no explanation. Add a footnote or tooltip (名額可能只計單一班別) or flag it as a likely source error.
Phone: each result is a 330 px card, so 50 results make a 9,000 px page. Tighten cards to 3 lines (title / school·dept·teacher / term·time·count) and page 20 at a time with 'load more'.
keep: Result-count line and 本頁學校 chips with counts
Phone card footer pairs the term badge, course code and enrollment status
Pagination at both top and bottom

Show which filters were active (所有學校・全部學期) next to the message, each with a one-tap remove, so users can tell the empty result is not a filter mistake.
